signal: SuperAnnotate raised a Series B in 2025 backed by Databricks Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital, scaling its AI-ready data and model evaluation platform

email.body1:
Jason, saw SuperAnnotate scaling the data platform on the back of its Series B and Databricks Ventures backing.

Growth that fast usually means more in-market AI teams in play than your BD org can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for SuperAnnotate off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jason, quick follow-up for SuperAnnotate.

Post-raise, expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings SuperAnnotate needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jason, last bit of proof for SuperAnnotate.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how SuperAnnotate's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jason, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to SuperAnnotate either way.
